title: Eng ops commitments + decision log (all-hands) - Nov 18 2026
content:
Meeting: Engineering All-Hands — ops commitments & decision log
Date: 2026-11-18 10:00 PT (recording in #eng-all)
Owner / scribe: Asha Patel
Attendees: ~180 across eng org, breakout leads: Daniel Kim (SRE), Maya Thompson (Serving Runtime), Luis Garcia (Private Deployments), Ruth Chen (Console), Owen Martinez (Optimize)

TL;DR
- Focus for next 8 weeks: stabilize P95 latency on hosted API for long-context workloads, ship canary autoscaling policy for Dedicated, and finalize Private on-prem packaging checklist for pilot customer.
- Decisions today captured below with action owners and due dates. Commitments are timeboxed and prioritized for Q4 engineering backlog.

Agenda
1) Quick state of health and top metrics
2) Major product commitments and owners (8-week horizon)
3) Decisions / policy changes (routing, fallback, canary windows)
4) Breakouts + cross-team action items
5) Open risks and blockers
6) Q&A snippets and follow-ups

1) Health snapshot (presented by Daniel)
- Hosted API metrics (rolling 7d):
  - P50 token latency: 18ms (tgt <=20ms)
  - P95 token latency: 145ms (tgt <=120ms) — regression primarily during sequences >8192 tokens
  - Error budget burn: 0.9% last 7d (within SLA)
  - Avg tokens/sec per GPU: 4200 (up 8% week-over-week after kernel swap)
- Dedicated: sustained 95% capacity utilization on east-1 pools; burst policies hit twice this week and triggered fallback to secondary models once.
- Private: 2 active trials; one in final validation (customer infra team running end-to-end tests).

2) Commitments (8-week) — owners and measurable success criteria
- Reduce P95 for long-context hosted requests to <=120ms: Owner Maya Thompson. Plan: short-term KV cache improvements + kernel parameter tuning. Success metric: P95 <=120ms on long-context cohort (ids in EvalSet L8K). Due: 2026-01-10 (8 weeks).
- Canary autoscaling policy for Dedicated (rule-driven with burst buffer): Owner Ruth Chen. Deliverable: console toggle + rollout playbook + automated rollback. Success: Canary executes on test pool with no more than 2% request reroute. Due: 2026-12-16.
- Private packaging pilot: finalize on-prem tarball + KMS integration checklist: Owner Luis Garcia. Deliverable: signed checklist + pilot onboarding guide. Due: 2026-12-05.
- Cost/quantization recommendations (Optimize): Owner Owen Martinez. Deliverable: initial auto-suggest rules for 7 common workloads (chat, summarization, embeddings). Due: 2026-12-12.

3) Decisions (recorded for audit)
- DEC-2026-11-18-01: Short-circuit fallback change — default behavior when regional capacity is constrained will try model-variant downgrade (lower-spec quantized variant) before cross-region failover. Rationale: reduces cross-region network latency and cost. Owner: Product infra (Ruth). Effective: immediate for Hosted API; Dedicated opt-in.
- DEC-2026-11-18-02: Canary window set to 48 hours for Dedicated autoscale rollouts (up from 24h). Rationale: observed delayed memory-pressure regressions. Owner: Release Eng (Maya + Ruth). Action: implement automated extended observation signals.
- DEC-2026-11-18-03: Experimental rollout of prefix-KV caching heuristics for multi-tenant workloads (tiered TTLs). Trial group limited to customers flagged in EvalSet-KV. Owner: Serving Runtime (Maya).

4) Breakout notes + cross-team actions (quick bullets)
- SRE (Daniel):
  - Action SRV-A1: Add anomaly alert that ties P95 regression to sequence-length histogram in Datadog (owner: Daniel; due: 2026-11-25).
  - Investigate two incident postmortems where autoscaler doubled pods unnecessarily (linked to noisy-liveness probe); temp mitigation: adjust probe TTL to 15s.
- Serving Runtime (Maya):
  - Action SRV-A2: Implement KV cache prefetching for known prefix patterns observed in streaming chat (owner: Maya; due: 2026-12-08).
  - Experiment: run quantized kernel A/B on pool 7 (low priority customers) for 72h.
- Console + Rollouts (Ruth):
  - Action CON-A1: Ship UI for canary policy configuration (owner: Ruth; UX: Priya Shah; due: 2026-12-02).
  - Add per-customer rollout timeline view to reduce operator confusion during multi-customer rollouts.
- Private Deployments (Luis):
  - Action PRIV-A1: Finalize HSM/KMS integration doc for air-gapped installs; add sample Ansible playbook (owner: Luis; due: 2026-11-30).
  - Pilot checklist: confirm network egress exception list with legal.
- Optimize (Owen):
  - Action OPT-A1: Build small rule engine to recommend quantization + batching profile given token distribution sample (owner: Owen; due: 2026-12-12).
  - Collect 10 real-customer prompts for quality baseline evaluation.

5) Open risks & blockers
- Risk R-01: Long-context memory pressure — if kernel-level optimizations don’t reduce KV footprint, we may require temporary routing to medium-sized models for >16k sequences. Mitigation: prepare customer comms draft and fallback pricing.
- Risk R-02: On-prem pilot dependency on customer infra timeline (two-week lag). Blocker: legal review of data-handling addendum. Owner: Luis + Legal; expected unblock date: 2026-11-26.

6) Q&A notes (selected)
- Q: Will fallback decision (DEC-2026-11-18-01) impact latency SLAs? A: Minor impact for a small % of requests; product will surface fallback events in console and billing metadata.
- Q: What happens if canary rollback triggers in Dedicated during holiday window? A: We will enforce blackout periods for critical customer rollouts and require on-call lead approval.

Appendix: Action tracker (short)
- SRV-A1 | Daniel Kim | 2026-11-25 | alert + dashboard
- SRV-A2 | Maya Thompson | 2026-12-08 | KV prefetch prototype -> perf run
- CON-A1 | Ruth Chen | 2026-12-02 | canary UI + docs
- PRIV-A1 | Luis Garcia | 2026-11-30 | HSM/KMS doc + playbook
- OPT-A1 | Owen Martinez | 2026-12-12 | suggestion rules v0

Notes to self / rough ideas captured during Q&A (informal)
- Explore weekend runbooks for high-volume model releases (mini postmortem every 24h).
- Consider small monthly "customer-signal" channel to highlight quality regressions vs. cost trades (product + CS).
- Potential follow-up all-hands deep-dive on quantization tradeoffs early Dec (Maya + Owen).

Attachments/links (quick)
- Corpus: EvalSet-L8K (internal)
- Incident postmortems: incident/SRV-2026-11-10 & incident/SRV-2026-11-12
- Playbook draft: confluence:dedicated-canary-playbook-v0

If you own an action above, paste updates in this doc thread before EOD Friday and add any blocking tickets in Linear with the SRV-* prefix.

-- Asha
